main_text.p: R.quia nō reliqui nauim, sed in ea permāsi. nauim autem relinquere eft, ab ipsa discede[illegible, ~4 letters]re. F. Imò nauim relinquere[illegible, ~6 letters] est, curam & tutelam eius penitus ex animo deponere.[illegible, ~5 letters] Quid enim interest, utrū ex naui descendas, an eam susq; deque feras? tu uero non modo nauis, uerum etiam tuæ salutis conseruādæ animum despondisti. D. Reliquerit' ne nauim is, qui cum in ea manserit, animum tamē non modò nauis, sed etiam suæ ipsius salutis tuendæ abiece-rit? Responderem, reliquisse. finem enim legis fuisse, ut naui quamplurimum præsidij
main_text.notes: Marginal notes on the right are Greek and could not be read; their letter counts are estimates. The running head is read as "IVRIS CONSVLTVS" from the overlapping letters at the top. The page ends mid-sentence, so the paragraph continues on the next page.
